zh: 嗨年轻人，别再只问 AI 会不会替代你。
en: Young people, stop only asking whether AI will replace you.

zh: 你更应该问：能不能借 AI，把身边的真实资源变成有人愿意买单的交付？
en: Ask whether you can use AI to turn nearby real resources into a paid deliverable.

zh: 这就是我的理解：OPC，一人有限公司。
en: That is my understanding of OPC: a one-person company.

zh: 先说清楚，它不是让你一个人把所有活儿都干完。
en: To be clear, it does not mean doing every task alone.

zh: 更不是今天听到概念，明天就去注册公司。
en: And it does not mean registering a company right after hearing the concept.

zh: 在 AI 时代，它更像是一种工作方式，一个人对客户判断和结果负责。
en: In the AI era, it is more like a way of working: one person owns the client, judgment, and result.

zh: AI 帮你把内容、调研、页面、流程这些重复活干得更快一点。
en: AI helps you do repeated work like content, research, pages, and workflows faster.

zh: 很多人觉得机会都在北上广深，西北年轻人没资源、没团队、没资金。
en: Many people think opportunities are only in big coastal cities, and Northwest young people lack resources, teams, and capital.

zh: 但你仔细看，兰州和甘肃真正不缺的是场景。
en: But if you look closely, Lanzhou and Gansu do not lack real scenarios.

zh: 你家里可能做餐饮，同学可能做设计，亲戚认识装修公司、民宿、家具店。
en: Your family may run a restaurant, your classmates may design, and your relatives may know renovation firms, homestays, or furniture stores.

zh: 或者你自己就熟悉一个县城、一条街、一个行业。
en: Or you may know one county, one street, or one industry well.

zh: 这些不是落后的资源，反而是你比外地人更容易拿到的真实问题。
en: These are not backward resources. They are real problems you can access more easily than outsiders.

zh: 做 OPC，不是先学一百个 AI 工具，而是先凑齐三样东西。
en: To build an OPC, do not start by learning a hundred AI tools. Start with three things.

zh: 第一，你能接触到一个真实场景。
en: First, you can access a real scenario.

zh: 第二，你能用 AI 做出一个看得见的交付。
en: Second, you can use AI to create a visible deliverable.

zh: 第三，你愿意拿着这个交付去换一次真实反馈。
en: Third, you are willing to trade that deliverable for real feedback.

zh: 比如你认识一个餐饮店，就别去空谈智能体。
en: For example, if you know a restaurant, do not talk abstractly about agents.

zh: 先拿一张新菜图片，帮他做三条短视频文案、一张活动海报，再整理十条客户评价。
en: Use one dish photo to make three short-video scripts, one campaign poster, and organize ten customer reviews.

zh: 老板愿不愿意用？有没有省下时间？下次愿不愿意继续找你？
en: Will the owner use it? Did it save time? Would they come back to you next time?

zh: 这才是你真正的第一份 OPC 资料。所以别一上来就说我要做平台、做 APP、做一家公司。
en: That is your first real OPC asset. So do not start by saying you want to build a platform, an app, or a company.

zh: 你先做一个小闭环：找一个行业，盯住一个重复动作，交一份结果，拿一次反馈。
en: Start with a small loop: choose one industry, focus on one repeated action, deliver one result, and get one piece of feedback.

zh: 你会剪辑，就帮本地商家把产品资料变成内容。
en: If you can edit, turn local merchants product materials into content.

zh: 你会设计，就把混乱的介绍变成成交的页面。
en: If you can design, turn a messy introduction into a page that helps conversion.

zh: 你会用 AI 写代码，就去解决一个老板每天要重复的流程。
en: If you can code with AI, solve one workflow a business owner repeats every day.

zh: 先让一个人说：这个对我有用，再谈规模化。
en: First get one person to say this is useful. Then talk about scale.

zh: 我现在在兰州做的也是这件事。
en: This is also what I am doing now in Lanzhou.

zh: 不是先卖一套很大的课，也不是先搭建一个很大的平台。
en: I am not starting by selling a huge course or building a huge platform.

zh: 而是先把本地企业的真实问题，翻译成 AI 能做的小应用、小流程和小交付。
en: I am first translating local business problems into small AI apps, workflows, and deliverables.

zh: 跑通以后，再把记录公开出来。
en: After it works, I will publish the record.

zh: 我需要的也不是一群只会聊概念的人。
en: I am not looking for people who only talk concepts.

zh: 我更想找到有本地场景、有一项技能、愿意一起打样的年轻人。
en: I want young people with local scenarios, one useful skill, and the willingness to build prototypes together.

zh: 评论区留下三件事：你的城市、你会什么、你身边有什么行业资源。
en: Leave three things in the comments: your city, what you can do, and what industry resources you have nearby.

zh: OPC 不是一个人孤军奋战，是一个人带着 AI，先把身边的问题解决掉。
en: OPC is not fighting alone. It is one person using AI to solve nearby problems first.

zh: 我是超哥，在兰州记录 AI 创业。
en: I am Chao, recording AI entrepreneurship in Lanzhou.
